content.short: AlphaWallet is an open-source, 100% self-custody Web3 wallet for DeFi and NFTs.
content.description: AlphaWallet is a simple, secure Ethereum wallet that natively supports ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155, and ERC875 tokens. As a multi-chain wallet, it can store a wide range of Ethereum-based networks, including PoS Mainnet, Polygon (Matic), xDai, Binance Smart Chain (BSC), Heco, ARTIS sigma1, Fantom Opera, Avalanche, Optimistic, Arbitrum One, and other compatible networks. Developers can use the open-source programmable blockchain apps platform.
